learning_objective: 🎯 Understand what AI is, discover its three main domains, and explore the ethical questions we must ask when building smart machines!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Artificial Intelligence is the ability of a machine or a computer program to think and learn like a human. It involves mimicking human cognitive functions like learning, problem-solving, and decision-making.

AI is the broad concept of smart machines. Machine Learning (ML) is a subset of AI where we train machines with data instead of giving them explicit rules. Deep Learning (DL) is a further subset of ML inspired by the human brain (Neural Networks) to handle complex tasks.

AI operates mainly in three areas: Data Science (working with numbers and tabular data), Computer Vision (giving machines the ability to 'see' images and videos), and Natural Language Processing (teaching machines to understand and speak human language).

As AI becomes smarter, we must address ethical concerns. These include Data Privacy (how our data is used), AI Bias (when AI makes unfair decisions based on flawed data), and the fear of AI replacing human jobs.

fun_activity.title: 🔍 AI Detective in Your Home
fun_activity.instructions: Walk around your house and list 3 things that use AI. (Hint: Does your TV recommend movies? Do you have a smart speaker like Alexa? Does your phone group photos by faces?). Identify which AI domain (Data, CV, or NLP) each one uses!

exam_tips: 📌 Always use the concentric circle diagram to explain the relationship between AI (outermost), ML (middle), and DL (innermost).
📌 Be prepared to classify real-world apps into the three domains: E.g., Siri = NLP, Face Unlock = Computer Vision, Netflix Recommendations = Data Science.
📌 AI Bias is a frequently asked topic. Explain it by giving an example: an AI trained only on pictures of white cats might not recognize a black cat.
quick_recap: ⭐ AI aims to create machines that simulate human intelligence.
⭐ The three core domains of AI are Data Science, Computer Vision, and NLP.
⭐ Ethical AI development ensures fairness, privacy, and safety for humans.
